_README: TEMPLATE for the owner-only half of the training charter (#5087). Copy to config/training_charter.private.local.json (gitignored) and fill it, or put the same object in env TRAINING_CHARTER_PRIVATE_JSON, or at the owner-private S3 key config/coaching/training_charter.private.json. The repo is PUBLIC: no real value ever goes in a tracked file. lambdas/training/training_charter.py merges this over the public config/training_charter.json and reports private_loaded + private_keys; nothing under these keys is ever on the PUBLISHED_WHITELIST. anchor_foods (#5103) is the weekly menu's anchor-food table: one row per food with a stable id, the label and serving as the owner writes them, the label values per serving (kcal, protein_g, carb_g, fat_g, fibre_g), an optional max_per_day (replaces the charter's default per-food cap for that row), off_limits true to keep a food off the menu, and the package it is bought in (servings per package) for the grocery list; health.weekly_menu reads it. Optional food-quality tags (#5105, read by health.food_quality): fatty_fish true marks a fatty-fish food (the charter's nutrition.food_quality.fatty_fish weekly range counts its servings; the fibre per serving is the row's fibre_g), and nutrient_tags is a list of short words the lab-driven priorities row can name (the week's servings of those foods are reported beside it).
